LESSON: CALL TO PROPHETHOOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.1: Call to Prophethood

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Call to Prophethood. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Call to Prophethood
2. Practise Call to Prophethood at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Call to Prophethood

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Call to Prophethood
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Call to Prophethood. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Call to Prophethood at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Call to Prophethood at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Call to Prophethood
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Call to Prophethood. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Call to Prophethood using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Call to Prophethood in the examples.
2. Explain Call to Prophethood to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Call to Prophethood.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Call to Prophethood using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Call to Prophethood important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Call to Prophethood
2. Practise Call to Prophethood at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Call to Prophethood

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
